faqs.question: Is my home suitable for solar?
faqs.answer: Most homes with an unobstructed southern, western, or eastern roof exposure in sound structural condition are prime candidates. We perform a LiDAR satellite scan to calculate your exact roof pitch, shading metrics, and usable surface area.

faqs.question: How much can I save?
faqs.answer: Clients typically offset 70% to 100% of their utility bill, resulting in $35,000 to $90,000+ in lifetime savings depending on electricity rates, system capacity, and available 30% federal tax incentives.

faqs.question: Do batteries work during outages?
faqs.answer: Yes. Our high-voltage LFP battery configurations feature automated microgrid islanding switchgear that engages in under 4 milliseconds, providing uninterrupted backup power for critical circuits or whole-home loads.

faqs.question: How long does installation take?
faqs.answer: Physical installation typically takes 1 to 3 days for residences and 1 to 3 weeks for commercial sites. The comprehensive timeline from design and municipal permitting to utility grid interconnection is normally 3 to 6 weeks.
